name: annStrata SV model
scope: Manta DEL/INS/DUP calls of 50 bp - 5 Mb on autosomes and chrX; INV/BND, chrY/chrM, other contigs and other sizes are not scored
inputs: single-sample short-read SV VCF (Manta; Delly / LUMPY parsed to the same feature concepts) + GRCh38 FASTA + bundled GIAB and RepeatMasker BEDs; no BAM
truth: 2-of-3 consensus of Sniffles2, cuteSV and Sawfish on PacBio HiFi (Truvari collapse r500 / pctsize 0.7 / pctseq 0.7, same type; Sniffles_cuteSV_Sawfish_2of3_r500_p0.7_P0.7_max5Mb), HPRC 274 genomes
labels: Truvari 5.3.0 bench per sample: refdist 500, pctsize 0.7, pctseq 0.7, pctovl 0, sizemin/sizefilt 50, sizemax 5 Mb, dup-to-ins, no-roll, pick single; discordant (FP) = 1
training_rows: one row per call; 2,487,530 DEL/INS/DUP calls on autosomes and chrX, discordance 20.2573%

endpoints.error_probability: P(call is discordant with the long-read 2-of-3 consensus); LightGBM binary classifier + global isotonic calibration (fitted on sample-split OOF)

early_stopping: 10% of samples held out (seed 0), patience 50, max 10000 rounds

calibration.fitted_on: sample-split OOF of run lgbm (2,487,530 Manta DEL/INS/DUP calls on autosomes and chrX, 274 samples)

feature_code: feature_builder.py (the same code produced the training features; columns selected and renamed per source_column; sentinel -99999 read as missing)
validation: 5-fold CV, sample-group and 10-Mb block splits reported side by side: cv/lgbm/REPORT.md, CALIBRATION.md
